# Juke Box Label Generator Project

This is a Python project for generating PDF juke box labels with configurable backgrounds based on genre.

## Project Overview
- Generate PDF files containing arrays of juke box labels
- Each label displays: Artist name, A side track name, B side track name, Genre
- Configurable backgrounds with default genre-based lookup
- Uses ReportLab for PDF generation
- Supports custom label dimensions in millimeters
- Uses uv for dependency management

## Development Guidelines
- Follow Python best practices and PEP 8 style guidelines
- Use type hints where appropriate
- Include comprehensive error handling
- Maintain modular code structure with separate classes for label generation, data handling, and configuration
- Test with various genre types and label configurations
- Use uv for all dependency management and script execution
